goal: Reconcile the independent Community Cloud runtime CORS response with S2 while preserving current exact-origin security and the conservative S11 header union.

worktree.head: a6b2fc473597abd844b1d72f51245c804d8670e9
worktree.rule: Preserve the current branch tip. Do not reset, rebase, switch, stash, clean, or discard its four committed changes.

excluded: all contracts, gateway, request-handler, docs, dependency, lockfile, frontend, installation, deployment, provider, credential, AI, STT, and Windows work
requiredBehavior: Allow methods GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, OPTIONS.
Allow request-header union Authorization, Content-Type, If-Match, Idempotency-Key, X-Request-ID, X-Region. Retain Idempotency-Key and X-Region; this assignment does not decide their later removal.
Expose ETag, X-Request-ID, X-CCC-Installation-Id and set Access-Control-Max-Age to 600.
Keep Vary: Origin, exact byte-equal allowlisted origin echo, absent Access-Control-Allow-Credentials, null and outside-origin 403 without ACAO, and absent-Origin responses without CORS headers.
Reject TRACE and unknown requested headers with 403 and no ACAO. Do not manufacture ETag, request IDs, region values, cookies, wildcard origins, proxy behavior, or CSP changes.
verification: Use LSP references before changing exported symbols when available.
Run only the targeted Community Cloud runtime test file; do not run project-wide suites, linters, or formatters.
Commit only the two allowed explicit paths locally. Do not push, merge, deploy, or contact external services.
report: At completion print the marker, commit SHA, changed paths, exact verification counts, and any blocker.
